Source is Ryanair Holdings plc's FY2025 Form 20-F as filed with the SEC (filed May 19, 2025), which reports in euro, so currency is EUR. OWNERSHIP: the 20-F's major-shareholder table is as of March 31, 2025 and is 'based on information available to Ryanair Holdings'. It does not cite individual holder filings, so each holder's asOf is the table date. Percentages are '% of Class' of the 1,063,868,001 Ordinary Shares outstanding. O'LEARY: 44,099,892 Ordinary Shares (4.1%); the Directors as a group held 44,774,182 shares, about 4%. His relation is 'ceo' (Group CEO; data.js role 'Group CEO'). HSBC Holdings PLC is typed 'other' because the 20-F does not say whether it holds for its own account or as custodian or nominee. STOCK COMP: €12.8m, which rounds to 0.01 billion; FY2024 was a credit of €3.9m. Share awards are made under Option Plan 2013 and LTIP 2019, which the 20-F describes in terms of senior employees, managers and directors; no broad employee share purchase plan was found in the 20-F, so plan is null. DIVIDENDS: €437.7m paid in FY2025 (Note 24). BUYBACKS: €1,477.8m in FY2025 under the €700m program launched in May 2024 and the €800m follow-on launched in August 2024.

footprint.notes: The FY2025 20-F lists Ryanair's 93 operating bases (as of May 16, 2025) by airport name only, with no country or per-base aircraft, passenger or staff counts. Counting bases per country would mean mapping airports to countries ourselves, so no country rows were made. Employees by country come from the FY2025 Annual Report's sustainability statement (Table 34, countries with at least 10% of staff: Spain, UK, Italy, Ireland; all others are 'Other', not broken down). No passengers-by-country or taxes-by-country disclosure was found in the 20-F, the Annual Report 2025 or the FY25 Sustainability Report (corporate.ryanair.com); revenue by country (only where above 10%) is already in the records. The Annual Report also says FY25 opened 4 new bases (Dubrovnik, Reggio Calabria, Tangier, Trieste). Sites are 12 of the 'principal facilities owned or leased by the Ryanair Group' table (site area and floor space in square meters, not recorded as values); the same table also lists East Midlands (simulator training), Travel Labs offices in Madrid and Wroclaw, and administrative offices in Warsaw, Pieta (Malta) and Vienna.
